description: Lists the identity verifications belonging to a user, with the outcome of each. Requires: userId (from profile_get). Items are { id, email, name, firstSurname, secondSurname, status, identificationType, createdAt, createdBy, rejectedReason, rejectedContext }, so this is where you read whether a verification succeeded and, when it did not, why. Supports filter, order and page. This is the only way to observe an id_verification_video_create, which returns no body. PERMIT-GATED: returns 403 with code NoIdVerificationsPermit when profile_get reports permit.idVerifications === false.
name: id_verification_list
